---
name: sdlc
description: Start or resume the complete visible, evidence-gated program SDLC loop
agent: gts-orchestrator
argument-hint: "<change-id> <feature or bug> <DFS/FSD/Jira sources> [seed repositories]"
---

Own the supplied change through the complete program SDLC. Start by creating a
visible task list in both the VS Code todo control and Chat. Assess source
sufficiency before planning; ask the user concrete questions and wait when
Jira/DFS/FSD content, GUI baselines, affected behavior, or acceptance criteria
are missing. Run all required digest-bound plan review and re-review cycles,
then obtain Human Gate 1 from external independent evidence. After approval,
follow every supervisor task lease and its visible RED,
GREEN, verification, GTS expert-review, build and handoff subtasks. Continue
until Human Gate 2 or a real fail-closed blocker. Do not require GitHub CLI for
VS Code Chat execution and never treat a narrative completion claim as
evidence.
